analysis.summary: Gandhar Oil Refinery reported its highest ever quarterly revenue in Q2 FY27, driven by strong performance across key segments and elevated gross margin spreads. Management highlighted ongoing operational challenges due to geopolitical tensions in West Asia and shipping disruptions affecting base oil availability and export volumes at its UAE subsidiary, Texol. Despite these headwinds, domestic volumes grew healthily and consolidated borrowings decreased, leaving the company net cash positive. The company plans to maintain its focus on value-added products, operational efficiency, and disciplined capital allocation. Management reported the highest-ever quarterly performance for Q2 FY27, with revenue reaching ₹1,847 crore and profit after tax standing at approximately ₹392 crore for H1 FY27.

guidance.claim: Management stated they remain quite optimistic and positive about achieving their current gross margin run rate for the coming quarters, Q3 and Q4.
guidance.quote: Obviously, we are quite optimistic. We will continue -- we are quite optimistic and quite positive in achieving this run rate even for the quarters to come, Q3 and Q4, we are quite optimistic.

guidance.claim: Management stated they are hopeful of margins remaining at or around current levels for the whole year.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of the margins remaining at this level or around this level. The current quarter looks good. And we are hopeful of it carrying forward at these levels for the whole year.

guidance.claim: The company targets a volume growth range of 8% to 10% to 11% for the year.
guidance.quote: Historically, we've always been doing volume growth in the range of 8% to 10% to even 11%. So, we see ourselves getting that much of volume growth during this year also.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates that export revenue and sales will remain at the same level for coming quarters.
guidance.quote: We anticipate the export revenue and the export sales will be in the same level for the quarters to come.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates that the growth trend for the PHPO and process and insulating oil segments will continue to be similar for the next quarters.
guidance.quote: So, these are the two segments where we anticipate the growth will be similar. The trend will continue to be similar for the next quarters as well.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates that margins will continue to be at stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters.
guidance.quote: But obviously, we anticipate the margins would be continued to be at a stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters to come.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that demand from the healthcare and pharmaceutical sectors remained steady.
demand_outlook.quote: However, demand from the health care and pharmaceutical sectors remained steady.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed healthy demand from transformers, power, and the rubber industry driving the Process and Insulating Oil segment.
demand_outlook.quote: The growth was driven by healthy demand from the transformers, power and the rubber industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted robust increase in demand from the power sector contributed by addition of data centers and increment of power requirement across the country.
demand_outlook.quote: See, there has been a robust increase in the demand from the power sector contributed by addition of data centers, increment of the power requirement across the country.

demand_outlook.claim: The company saw strong traction in PIO with half yearly volumes growing 23% year-on-year, supported by demand from the transformer, power, and rubber industries.
demand_outlook.quote: We continued to see strong traction in PIO, with half yearly volumes growing 23% year-on-year, supported by demand from the transformer, power and rubber industries.

demand_outlook.claim: Lubricants volumes improved sequentially during the period.
demand_outlook.quote: Lubricants volumes improved sequentially, while in PHPO, we remain focused on addressing changing customer requirements and competitive dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: Performance during the quarter was driven by a healthy demand environment across key end-user industries.
demand_outlook.quote: Our performance during this quarter was driven by a healthy demand environment across our key end-user industries, coupled with disciplined execution across the businesses.

demand_outlook.claim: The PIO business delivered a robust performance growing 28% year-on-year supported by healthy demand from transformer, power, and rubber manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: Our PIO business also delivered a robust performance, growing 28% year-on-year, supported by healthy demand from the transformer, power and the rubber manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: The transformer oil or PIO category is expected to have strong and robust growth due to increasing electricity requirements globally and in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Thanks to the increasing requirement of electricity, not only in India, but globally; we anticipate even our transformer oil that is the PIO category to have a strong and robust growth for the future and the quarters to come.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that installed capacity on a consolidated basis now stands at 838,637 kiloliters.
capex_expansion.quote: Our installed capacity on a consolidated basis now stands at 838,637 kiloliters.

capex_expansion.claim: Management explained that the capacity enhancement was on account of the capitalization of capital WIP over the last few quarters.
capex_expansion.quote: which is basically on account of the capitalization over the last few quarters of the capital WIP.

capex_expansion.claim: Management reported that installed capacity for the Indian plants now stands at 602,713 kiloliters.
capex_expansion.quote: Having enumerated the same, our installed capacity for the Indian plants now stood at 602,713.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed a debottlenecking programme during the quarter to strengthen operating capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: We also completed a debottlenecking programme during the quarter, strengthening our operating capacity.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that gross profit for the quarter stood at INR388 crores with a gross margin of 21%.
margins_costs.quote: The gross profit stood at INR388 crores compared with INR130 crores in Q2 FY '26 with a gross margin of 21%.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that the gross margin spread was approximately INR29,128 per kl.
margins_costs.quote: The gross margin spread was approximately INR29,128 per kl compared with INR9,000 per kl in Q2 FY '26 and INR28,000 per kl in Q1 FY '27.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that an ex gratia of INR15 crores to INR16 crores was paid across the board to everybody, impacting employee expenses.
margins_costs.quote: There is a INR15 crores -- INR16 crores ex gratia which has been paid across the board to everybody.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that insurance rates have gone up along with war risk premiums for vessels coming out of Hormuz.
margins_costs.quote: Insurance rates have gone up ma'am.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin spread was sustained at ₹29,128 per kl, 3.0x year-on-year and in line with Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin Spread sustained at ₹29,128 per kl, 3.0x year-on-year and in line with Q1 FY27

margins_costs.claim: The company sustained healthy gross margin spreads for the second consecutive quarter.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved our highest-ever quarterly revenue of ₹1,847 crore, while sustaining healthy gross margin spreads for the second consecutive quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue increased by 92% year-on-year to INR 1,731.9 crores and gross margin spread expanded 3.4x year-on-year to INR 28,145 per kilolitre.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, the consolidated revenue increased by 92% year-on-year to INR 1,731.9 crores, while the gross margin spread expanded to 3.4x Y-o-Y basis to INR 28,145 per kilolitre compared to quarter 1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax grew by approximately 688% year-on-year to INR 206 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax stood at INR206 crores compared with INR26 crores in Q1 FY26 and INR37 crores in Q4 FY26, representing a growth of approximately 688% year-on-year and 456% quarter-on-quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted they do not carry much inventory to justify inventory gains or losses, carrying raw material inventories generally up to 30, 35, 40 days.
margins_costs.quote: We don't carry that much of inventory to justify inventory gains or inventory losses. On the raw material front, we carry inventories generally up to 30, 35, 40 days.

margins_costs.claim: The gross margin for the quarter on a consolidated level was 21.4%.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the current capacity utilization on a stand-alone level is 82% to be precise.
orders_capacity.quote: So, I can tell you currently, currently the utilization on stand-alone level is 80%, 82% to be precise.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported that at the consolidated level, capacity utilization is around 61%.
orders_capacity.quote: The consol level, it is around 61%.

orders_capacity.claim: Total sales volume during the quarter stood at approximately 131,000 kilolitres compared with approximately 121,000 kilolitres in Q1 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Total sales volume during the quarter stood at approximately 131,000 kilolitres compared with approximately 121,000 kilolitres in Q1 FY26, reflecting a growth of around 8% year-on-year.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that consolidated borrowings reduced to about INR85 crores as on 30th September 2026 from INR168 crores in March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Consolidated borrowings which relate mainly to trade finance and borrowings at our overseas Texol level reduced to about INR85 crores as on 30th September '26 from INR168 crores in March '26.

capital_allocation.claim: Management noted that total equity increased to INR1,771 crores from INR1,400 crores in March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Total equity increased to INR1,771 crores from INR1,400 crores in March '26.

capital_allocation.claim: CRISIL reaffirmed A+/Stable and A1 ratings and rated bank facilities to ₹1,014 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: • CRISIL reaffirmed A+/Stable and A1 ratings; rated bank facilities to ₹1,014 crore

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared an interim dividend of 100% of the face value of the shares.
capital_allocation.quote: We are also glad to inform that we have declared an interim dividend of 100% of the face value of our share.

capital_allocation.claim: The standalone company is effectively debt-free, while consolidated borrowings primarily relate to normal trade finance arrangements and overseas borrowings at Texol.
capital_allocation.quote: The company continues to maintain a strong financial position on a stand-alone basis. We remain effectively debt-free, while consolidated borrowings primarily relate to normal trade finance arrangements and borrowings at our overseas subsidiary, Texol.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated they intend to use about INR 20 crores of the quarter's performance for payment of the interim dividend.
capital_allocation.quote: Currently, we have decided to use about INR20 crores of this for payment of interim dividend.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted ongoing tensions in West Asia and disruptions to global shipping routes as continuing challenges in the operating environment.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operating environment during this quarter continues to remain challenging with ongoing tensions in the West Asia and disruptions to the global shipping routes.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management reported that flooding at Silvassa resulted in an inventory loss of approximately INR21 crores presented as an exceptional item.
risks_headwinds.quote: The flooding at Silvassa resulted in an inventory loss of approximately INR21 crores. As this is a onetime event, we have presented it as an exceptional item.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical developments in West Asia impacted base oil availability, pricing, and shipping logistics during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter presented operational challenges, particularly due to geopolitical developments in West Asia, which impacted base oil availability, pricing and shipping logistics.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heavy rainfall and flooding caused disruption at the Silvassa Unit No. 2 in July.
risks_headwinds.quote: Following the disruption caused by heavy rainfall and flooding at our Silvassa Unit No. 2 in July, we restored operations in early August through the focused efforts of our teams.

risks_headwinds.claim: The operating environment was challenged by geopolitical tension in the Middle East, Strait of Hormuz concerns, and crude/base oil pricing volatility.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operating environment remained challenging, shaped by heightened geopolitical tension in the Middle East, concerns surrounding the Strait of Hormuz, volatility in the crude oil and the base oil pricing and intermittent disruptions across the global supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Texol operations were temporarily impacted during Q1 by regional supply constraints and vessel movement disruptions arising from the geopolitical situation.
risks_headwinds.quote: During this period -- during the period of quarter 1, operations were temporarily impacted by regional supply constraints and disruption in vessel movements arising from the geopolitical situation.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to remaining focused on strengthening customer relationships and addressing evolving market dynamics in the PHPO segment.
management_commitments.quote: The PHPO continues to be our largest and the most important product category, and we remain focused on strengthening our customer relationships and addressing evolving market dynamics.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to continuing to focus on expanding the customer base, strengthening existing relationships, and improving the product mix in the lubricant business.
management_commitments.quote: We view this sequential improvement positively and we will continue to focus on expanding our customer base, strengthening existing relationships and improving our product mix to support our future growth.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that priorities remain focused on funding growth CapEx largely through internal accruals and maintaining a prudent balance sheet.
management_commitments.quote: Our priorities remain focused on funding growth CapEx largely through internal accruals, maintaining a prudent balance sheet and creating sustainable long-term value for our shareholders.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company will continue to emphasize disciplined working capital management, operational efficiency, and prudent capital allocation.
management_commitments.quote: We will continue to emphasize disciplined working capital management, operational efficiency and prudent capital allocation while ensuring that our financial strength supports the company's long-term growth objectives.

management_commitments.claim: The company will continue to focus on improving operational efficiency, deepening customer engagement, expanding geographic presence, and progressing capacity-expansion plans.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we will continue to focus on improving operational efficiency, deepening customer engagement, expanding our presence across geographies and progressing our capacity-expansion plans.

management_commitments.claim: Management is hopeful of margins remaining at or around current levels for the whole year.
management_commitments.quote: We are hopeful of the margins remaining at this level or around this level. The current quarter looks good. And we are hopeful of it carrying forward at these levels for the whole year.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets volume growth in the range of 8% to 10% to 11% during the year.
management_commitments.quote: Historically, we've always been doing volume growth in the range of 8% to 10% to even 11%. So, we see ourselves getting that much of volume growth during this year also.

management_commitments.claim: Management anticipates that export revenue and sales will remain at the same level for coming quarters.
management_commitments.quote: We anticipate the export revenue and the export sales will be in the same level for the quarters to come.

management_commitments.claim: Management anticipates that margins will continue to be at stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters.
management_commitments.quote: But obviously, we anticipate the margins would be continued to be at a stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters to come.
